notes.title: Dehoarder 2 Preview Demo 1 Now Available Exclusively to Patreon Patrons
notes.notes:
Today, I am overjoyed to bring you a very early first look at Dehoarder 2, with my release of Preview Demo 1 exclusively to [url=patreon.com/smilingcatentertainment]Beta Cat and higher tier patrons on Patreon[/url].

This is an important step toward an eventual Steam release of the game. By gathering feedback as early in the development process as possible, I hope to make this the best Dehoarding game it can be.

Remember that with your Beta Cat patronage, you get access to 2 great games: [url=https://smilingcatentertainment.itch.io/dehoarder-2]Preview access to Dehoarder 2 on itch.io[/url], plus a Steam Key for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805960/Prepare_For_Warp_Unlimited_Edition_Beyond_Insanji/]Prepare for Warp[/url]. Plus, you get to get involved in the development process by providing direct, constructive feedback about the game.

Show your support for this unique game by [url=patreon.com/smilingcatentertainment]becoming a patron[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/595670/Dehoarder_2/]Wishlisting on Steam[/url], and suggesting this game to your favorite streamers (or streaming it yourself). Only your support can make the completion of this game a possibility!

notes.title: Wishlist Dehoarder 2 Today!
notes.notes:
I interrupt your regularly scheduled midweek to bring a super important and exciting announcement: The Steam Coming Soon page for Dehoarder 2 is live!

Why is this announcement super important? Because it enables YOU to wishlist Dehoarder 2, and thus in aggregate lets me gauge how much interest there is in the game. Without your expression of interest, the future of the game could be jeopardized.

Why is this announcement exciting? Because Dehoarder 2 is shaping up to be my “biggest and bestest” game yet. Everything that I have learned over the years in regard to game development and much of what I’ve learned regarding life in general is going into this game.

So please Wishlist Dehoarder 2, so that I can bring to you this Magnum Opus of mine.
